use_cases.description: The agent is evaluated against simulated worlds, with run logs, token budgets, reports and a hosted runner, to produce verdicts on behavior.
use_cases.name: Agent proving ground

use_cases.description: A user asks Athena for something and the model engine (API or CLI) runs the turn: round loop, op grammar, tool calls, narration streamed back to the desktop companion.
use_cases.name: Agent turn execution

use_cases.description: Guided onboarding checks readiness of the daemon, engines and voice, and walks the user to a working install.
use_cases.name: First-run setup

use_cases.description: Risky tool calls are gated, the user approves or denies them in the companion, the decision is recorded, and every model invocation is written to the ledger.
use_cases.name: Gated action approval

use_cases.description: The user connects Gmail and Notion through OAuth. Tokens are stored in a sealed vault and the agent uses the connectors through ports.
use_cases.name: Gmail and Notion connectors

use_cases.description: Adversarial attacks delivered through page content are tested to confirm that gated tools and refusal rules hold.
use_cases.name: Injection resistance

use_cases.description: Example apps (Hirelane, TidyCRM, Ledgerbox, Atlas) use the shared zoom engine to move between levels while keeping identity, and expose the same view to the agent.
use_cases.name: Layered semantic-zoom UI

use_cases.description: The agent reads and acts on the user's open web page through the page bridge and browser lane, using the tools the page registers.
use_cases.name: Page operation via WebMCP

use_cases.description: The user browses playbooks, launches one, and the agent carries it out against a portal. The bench grades the result against the playbook's truth.
use_cases.name: Playbook execution

use_cases.description: A halo overlay and companion narration show Athena's state (idle, working, awaiting approval) in plain language alongside the user's page.
use_cases.name: Presence and halo signal

use_cases.description: Athena remembers episodes, facts and procedural notes, each with provenance enforced at write time, and recalls them in later turns.
use_cases.name: Provenance-backed memory

use_cases.description: The user speaks to Athena and hears replies, using Whisper speech-to-text, Kokoro text-to-speech, a voice gateway and spoken commands.
use_cases.name: Voice conversation
